claim: All 2,226 retained curves were reconstructed and normalized to a=1 or a=3. The smallest normalized 3b addition-chain lower bound was 242 operations, so no candidate passed the conservative 32-operation gate for a coefficient-specialized native benchmark.

cost_accounting.discovery_and_normalization: replay over frozen registries; wall time is not used as a performance claim
cost_accounting.native_coefficient_benchmark: not run because zero candidates passed the pre-implementation operation-count gate

decision: No coefficient-specialized candidate advances to native timing.

exploration_boundary.scope: normalized short-Weierstrass a in {1,3} and the 3b coefficient in the retained complete-addition formula

formula_gate.note: The gate screens implementation candidates; it is not a user-supplied numerical definition of dramatic.

limitations: the retained registry is not the entire finite isogeny-class orbit
operation-count bounds do not constitute a wall-time benchmark
no candidate passed the gate, so no coefficient-specialized rho implementation was built
other coordinate systems, formula families, deeper paths, and unknown ECDLP algorithms remain outside this audit
no new per-key transfer timing or full P-256 collision was performed
